<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap(tag):
    f=current_frame
    a=f.ascii.split('\n')
    pl=None
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='M' and n['pixels']>=18 and n['boundary'][0][0]<50:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            pl=(min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs))
    blocks={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in 'RbN' and n['pixels']==16 and n['boundary'][0][0]<50:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            blocks[n['color']]=(min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs))
    print(tag,"player",pl,blocks)
snap("before DOWN")
action(['DOWN'])
snap("after DOWN")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def snap(tag):
    f=current_frame

    print(tag,"player",pl,blocks)
